subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical Feishu invalid-token recovery branch after stronger proof is added, or choose a sibling implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97287?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a narrow code repair: multiple open branches implement the same recovery, and maintainers need to choose the preferred cache-invalidation scope and proof bar before merge.

options.title: Keep This Branch Canonical After Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted current-head terminal output, logs, or live run evidence that exercises the 99991663/99991664 recovery path, then use this branch if maintainers accept the all-cache invalidation scope.

options.title: Choose A Sibling Candidate
options.body: Select another open Feishu invalid-token PR if its account-scoped invalidation or smaller diff is preferred, then close this PR as superseded after preserving useful proof context.

options.title: Pause For Owner Design
options.body: Hold all candidate branches if Feishu owners want a different cache ownership design before invalid-token retry lands.

recommendation.title: Keep This Branch Canonical After Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-head terminal output, logs, or live run evidence that exercises the 99991663/99991664 recovery path, then use this branch if maintainers accept the all-cache invalidation scope.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp is the listed Feishu routing owner and merged the adjacent Feishu retry helper that this PR extends.
